cells.text: Does it have a deadline and an outcome?
Is it a standard you keep up forever?

text.text: Files move to the most actionable place; you can always move them out.
Four questions to place anything
Does it help finish something with an end date? File it under that project.
Does it support a responsibility with no end date (health, money, home)? File it under that area.
Is it a topic of general interest? Put it in resources.
Is it finished or stale? Move it to the archive.
